cds.title: Whitman College Common Data Set 2025-26 (PDF, Institutional Research)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (Fall 2025 entering class): 6,950 applied, 2,791 admitted, 373 enrolled; residency rows (in-state / out-of-state / international) add up to the totals. International (nonresident) first-years: 3,265 applied, 253 admitted, 40 enrolled. The ED figures cover Early Decision (542 applications, 114 admitted); the CDS reports no Early Action plan for fall 2025, while the 2026-27 admissions site lists one. GPA distribution is the 'all enrolled students' column (4.0 scale; the CDS prints 0.00% for the three lowest bands). SAT/ACT submission is optional: the CDS prints 25% (82 students) submitting SAT and 9% (30 students) ACT; those counts are not exactly those percentages of the 373 first-years. SAT composite percentiles are left out: the CDS prints 1190 / 1420 / 1415 for the 25th / 50th / 75th percentile, which is out of order (50th above 75th), so only the section scores and ACT are shown. CDS C7 leaves Recommendation(s), Alumni/ae relation and Religious affiliation unmarked, so those three factors are not recorded.

cost.notes: College Scorecard (data released 2026-10-15; IPEDS charges for 2025-26, which match the 2025-26 cost tables published by Berea, Pitzer and Scripps): tuition includes required fees; on-campus cost of attendance.
